preprocessing.orientationHandling: No EXIF orientation application; raw decoded pixel grid is used as returned by the decoder.
preprocessing.colorHandling: Use first three decoded channels; alpha is ignored; one-channel input is repeated across RGB calculations.

patchSelection.candidateGrid: Three evenly spaced x anchors by three evenly spaced y anchors on the native decoded grid, deduplicated.
patchSelection.ranking: Descending sampled local luminance variance; ties by y then x; no semantic or truth input.

features.definition: Mean absolute 3x3-excluding-center luminance residual over valid patch pixels.
features.preprocessing: Native decoded pixel values normalized to [0,1]; luminance is 0.299R+0.587G+0.114B.
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Excluded if calibration variance is at or below the declared variance floor.
features.missingValueHandling: Non-finite patch values are omitted; feature is unavailable if fewer than 80% of calibration vectors are finite.

features.definition: Root mean square of the 3x3-excluding-center luminance residual.
features.preprocessing: Native decoded pixel values normalized to [0,1].
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Excluded if calibration variance is at or below the declared variance floor.
features.missingValueHandling: Non-finite patch values are omitted.

features.definition: Approximate 90th percentile of absolute luminance residual using a fixed 256-bin histogram.
features.preprocessing: Native decoded pixel values normalized to [0,1]; histogram range is fixed at [0,1].
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Excluded if calibration variance is at or below the declared variance floor.
features.missingValueHandling: Histogram is unavailable when no valid residual pixels exist.

features.definition: 90th-percentile absolute residual divided by the median absolute residual plus a fixed epsilon.
features.preprocessing: Same fixed residual histogram as residualP90.
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 when the median residual is zero.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable when no valid residual pixels exist.

features.definition: Least-squares slope of absolute residual against center-pixel luminance.
features.preprocessing: Native decoded pixel values normalized to [0,1].
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 when luminance variance is degenerate.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable when fewer than two valid pixels exist.

features.definition: Squared correlation of absolute residual with center-pixel luminance.
features.preprocessing: Native decoded pixel values normalized to [0,1].
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 when luminance or residual variance is degenerate.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable when fewer than two valid pixels exist.

features.definition: Pearson correlation between 3x3 residuals of red and green channels.
features.preprocessing: Native decoded RGB channels; grayscale inputs repeat the single channel.
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 when either channel residual variance is degenerate.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable when fewer than two valid pixels exist.

features.definition: Pearson correlation between 3x3 residuals of red and blue channels.
features.preprocessing: Native decoded RGB channels; grayscale inputs repeat the single channel.
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 when either channel residual variance is degenerate.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable when fewer than two valid pixels exist.

features.definition: Pearson correlation between 3x3 residuals of green and blue channels.
features.preprocessing: Native decoded RGB channels; grayscale inputs repeat the single channel.
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 when either channel residual variance is degenerate.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable when fewer than two valid pixels exist.

features.definition: Range of per-channel mean absolute 3x3 residual energies.
features.preprocessing: Native decoded RGB channels normalized to [0,1].
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 for a constant channel-energy triplet.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable when no valid residual pixels exist.

features.definition: Normalized product correlation of luminance residuals at horizontal offset one.
features.preprocessing: Native decoded luminance residuals.
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 when residual energy is degenerate.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable when no valid offset pairs exist.

features.definition: Normalized product correlation of luminance residuals at vertical offset one.
features.preprocessing: Native decoded luminance residuals.
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 when residual energy is degenerate.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable when no valid offset pairs exist.

features.definition: Normalized product correlation of luminance residuals at diagonal offset (1,1).
features.preprocessing: Native decoded luminance residuals.
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 when residual energy is degenerate.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable when no valid offset pairs exist.

features.definition: Normalized product correlation of luminance residuals at diagonal offset (1,-1).
features.preprocessing: Native decoded luminance residuals.
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 when residual energy is degenerate.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable when no valid offset pairs exist.

features.definition: Variance of four 2x2 parity-bin mean squared residuals divided by mean residual energy.
features.preprocessing: Native decoded luminance residuals; parity is measured on native patch coordinates.
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 when mean residual energy is zero.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable when no valid residual pixels exist.

features.definition: Maximum-minus-minimum four-bin mean absolute residual divided by their mean plus epsilon.
features.preprocessing: Native decoded luminance residuals.
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 when all parity-bin means are zero.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable when no valid residual pixels exist.

features.definition: Mean absolute luminance residual where fixed local gradient is below the edge threshold.
features.preprocessing: Native decoded luminance and residuals; no semantic segmentation.
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 when no flat pixels are present.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable when neither flat nor edge pixels exist.

features.definition: Mean absolute luminance residual where fixed local gradient meets the edge threshold.
features.preprocessing: Native decoded luminance and residuals; no semantic segmentation.
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 when no edge pixels are present.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable when neither flat nor edge pixels exist.

features.definition: Edge residual mean divided by flat residual mean plus fixed epsilon.
features.preprocessing: Same fixed edge threshold as flatResidualAbsMean.
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 when no edge pixels exist.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable when no flat or edge pixels exist.

features.definition: Mean squared 3x3 residual divided by mean squared 5x5 residual.
features.preprocessing: Native decoded luminance; fixed 3x3 and 5x5 local means.
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 when the 5x5 residual energy is zero.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable when no valid interior pixels exist.

features.definition: 90th-percentile absolute 3x3 residual divided by 90th-percentile absolute 5x5 residual.
features.preprocessing: Fixed residual histograms with range [0,1].
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 when the 5x5 percentile is zero.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable when no valid interior pixels exist.

features.definition: Absolute difference between positive and negative luminance residual proportions.
features.preprocessing: Native decoded luminance residuals.
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 when no residual signs are observed.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable when no valid residual pixels exist.

features.definition: Median-absolute-deviation of selected-patch residualRms values divided by their median plus epsilon.
features.preprocessing: Derived only from per-patch pixel-domain residualRms.
features.aggregationRule: Robust relative dispersion across selected patches.
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 for fewer than two valid patch values.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable if all patch residualRms values are non-finite.

features.definition: Median-absolute-deviation of selected-patch residualCrossChannelCorrelationRG values.
features.preprocessing: Derived only from per-patch cross-channel residual correlation.
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 for fewer than two valid patch values.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable if all patch values are non-finite.

features.definition: Median-absolute-deviation of selected-patch horizontal residual autocorrelation.
features.preprocessing: Derived only from per-patch pixel-domain residual autocorrelation.
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 for fewer than two valid patch values.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable if all patch values are non-finite.

features.definition: Median-absolute-deviation of selected-patch parityPeriodicityEnergy values.
features.preprocessing: Derived only from per-patch native-grid parity periodicity.
features.degenerateFeatureHandling: Returns 0 for fewer than two valid patch values.
features.missingValueHandling: Unavailable if all patch values are non-finite.

primaryAggregation.withinGroup: Mean squared robust z distance over non-excluded feature scalars.
